the role of cerebral metabolism in determining the local cerebral blood flow (CBF) response to volatile anesthetics.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
isoflurance has a disproportionate effect upon neocortical blood flow, and a relatively small effect on neocortic metabolism.
, in the rat, the cerebral metabolic rate of glucose is a more important factor than cerebral blood flow in determining local cerebral blood flow effects of isoflurone and halothane anesthesia.
, in the rat, halothane anesthesia is characterized by a more uniform distribution of CBF and CMRglc throughout the brain.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the distribution of cerebral metabolism parallels that of cerebral blood flow.
the effects of halothane and of isoflurone on the local CBF are not only due to their effects on CBF, but that they also have a strong effect on the local CMRglc.
